title: Web map generation
description: B1: the effective configuration of the web map service, as generation.json in its own directory of the generations volume. The web map adopts a new generation in place. Its host port is no part of it: vhd apply publishes that port when it creates the container (G13).

generation.description: The generation number. A higher number replaces a lower one.

status_url.description: Where the service reports its status to the control plane.

status_interval_s.description: How often the service reports its status, in seconds.

database.description: Where the web map signs in to the database, as its own read-only role.
